dedupe_keys.name: статистика нкцки weekly activity results of russia s national coordination centre for computer incidents safe surf ru

description: NKCKI, Russia's National Coordination Centre for Computer Incidents, publishes weekly summaries of its activity results on safe-surf.ru, a user security portal created with its support. The statistics section read on 2026-09-28 is a paged list of weekly posts titled "Main results of NKCKI activity", covering periods such as 9 to 15 July, 16 to 22 July and 30 July to 5 August 2026 and published about a week after each period, alongside NKCKI bulletins, a vulnerability database and news. Coverage is Russia, as seen from the national incident coordination centre. Access is free to read; the site states all rights reserved, so reuse needs permission. Caveats: the figures are published as infographics, not data tables, their categories were not transcribed on the day, and counts reflect what the centre chooses to report. It supports time series of reported cyber incidents for threat context in studies of cyber attacks on critical infrastructure. Related record: data-kz-cert-incident-statistics gives comparable national CERT statistics for Kazakhstan.
